C0839.title: Weak Government Email Password Leads to Theft of 2,000 Classified Documents
C0839.summary: CCTV's Focus Report exposed a case where a local government employee used a three-letter username and set the office phone number as the password for convenience. This weak credential practice allowed nearly 2,000 sensitive files to be illegally accessed, including national defense information such as troop deployments, posing a severe national security threat.

references.title: Simple Passwords at Institutions Lead to Theft of 2,000 Classified Documents, Including Troop Deployment Info
